title: [mobile] Page scrolls horizontally: content is 587px wide in a 390px viewport
detail: At a 390px phone viewport: The page is wider than the viewport, so it scrolls sideways. Content is cut off until the user pans, and on touch devices vertical scrolling becomes unreliable. Horizontal scrolling on a page that is not meant to scroll sideways is one of the most common mobile layout defects.
remedy: Find the element wider than its container (reported alongside this) and constrain it: max-width:100%, flex-wrap, or overflow-wrap on long unbroken strings.
_note: a screenshot is attached in the `evidence` field of the real finding
